investigationSummary: `npm run lint` has never passed on this repo — it is not a regression. `npm run lint` exits 1 with 16 problems (11 errors, 5 warnings), contradicting CLAUDE.md, which documents the gate as 'zero warnings tolerated, not just zero errors'. Root cause of the state: eslint-plugin-react-hooks has been pinned at ^7.1.1 since the repository's initial commit (verified in package.json history), and v7's flat `recommended` config ships the React-Compiler-era rules with `set-state-in-effect` as `error`; nothing ever enforced the gate, since there is no lint job in CI (.github/workflows holds only bump-version.yml) and vite-plugin-eslint, though still a devDependency, is NOT wired into vite.config.ts, so the dev server doesn't lint on save. Per group: (1) 9 x @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, all in src/lib/chat/toolsCore.ts (lines 91, 532-592) — not a domain typing gap, just friction: executeTool already receives `args: Record<string, unknown>` and each case does `const a = args as any` purely to read a.table / a.filters / a.limit, while the file's own first case (list_tasks_marked_for_day) already demonstrates the correct in-house idiom, `const a = args as { date?: unknown }` plus typeof guards; the last two sites are `cleanPayload(obj: any): any` and `db.rpc(a.name as any, ...)`. (2) 2 x react-hooks/set-state-in-effect — AppShell.tsx:302 (closing drawer/sheet on route change) and CommandPalette.tsx:49 (clearing the query when the palette opens), both the 'reset state when something changes' case from React's You Might Not Need an Effect; key finding: the usual escape hatch of adjusting state during render is ALSO blocked, because the same recommended config enables react-hooks/set-state-in-render as `error`, so both fixes must remove the setState rather than relocate it. (3) 1 warning for an unused `strokeWidth` in StagingAcademyIcon.tsx — destructured deliberately to swallow it, since the mark is fill-only (fill="none" on the svg, fill={color} on the paths); probed and confirmed that ignoreRestSiblings does not cover function parameters but an `_` prefix does satisfy the configured argsIgnorePattern '^_'. (4) 4 x react-refresh/only-export-components in the three context modules (src/lib/activeEntityContext.tsx, src/lib/chat/chatActivityContext.tsx, src/lib/processingContext.tsx), each exporting a Provider component plus its consumer hook from one file — standard deliberate React practice, warning is only about dev-time HMR granularity. Also confirmed: docs/05-roadmap.md registers no phase this touches, so nothing contradicts the roadmap; eslint does lint supabase/functions/** and those files are currently clean; `eslint .` descends into .claude/worktrees/, so counts come back exactly doubled (32 instead of 16) while any worktree exists. The item was already open in docs/backlog.md as '`npm run lint` fails on main' (started 2026-09-30); this session appended its Investigation and Plan subsections there and moved it to the bottom of the Open table and section order per CLAUDE.md.
planSummary: Goal: `npm run lint` exits 0 with zero problems, so the gate CLAUDE.md documents becomes real. Behaviour-preserving throughout — no feature change. (1) eslint.config.ts: add '.claude' to the top-level `ignores`, so `eslint .` stops descending into .claude/worktrees/ and double-counting every problem — without this the implementation session can't trust its own counts. (2) src/lib/chat/toolsCore.ts: replace each `const a = args as any` with a locally declared `{ ...?: unknown }` shape plus typeof guards, following the list_tasks_marked_for_day case already in the file; widen the private assertAllowedTable(table: string) to accept `unknown` (it is a runtime membership check against ALLOWED_TABLES and is not exported); guard `select` / `orderBy` with `typeof x === 'string'`; pass `args` straight to coerceValues (its parameter is already Record<string, unknown>); retype cleanPayload as (value: unknown) => unknown; have search_schema guard args.query instead of casting. For `db.rpc(a.name as any, ...)`, try dropping the cast first and fall back to a narrower cast with a one-line justification only if the untyped SupabaseClient won't accept a plain string. executeTool's exported signature does NOT change, so src/lib/chat/tools.ts and supabase/functions/_shared/khaos.ts stay untouched. (3) src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx: delete the route-change effect and derive the overlays instead of storing them — keep the pathname each overlay was opened on (drawerOpenFor / chatSheetOpenFor) and compute `const drawerOpen = drawerOpenFor === location.pathname`; navigating makes the comparison false on its own, so the overlay closes with no setState in either an effect or render. The localStorage sidebar effect stays — it is a genuine external-system sync and is not flagged. (4) src/components/layout/CommandPalette.tsx: drop the `open` prop and the `if (!open) return null` early return, and have AppShell mount it conditionally ({paletteOpen && <CommandPalette onClose={...} />}); a fresh mount per open means useState('') already starts empty, so the query-clearing effect is deleted outright rather than rewritten. (5) src/components/icons/StagingAcademyIcon.tsx: rename the swallowed prop to `_strokeWidth` (probe-verified to satisfy argsIgnorePattern) with a short comment on why a fill-only mark drops it. (6) react-refresh/only-export-components — recommendation: do NOT split the three context modules, since splitting Provider from hook would add three files and churn 12 import sites to buy a dev-only HMR nicety, against a pattern the whole React ecosystem uses; instead add a `files`-scoped block in eslint.config.ts covering those modules that passes allowExportNames: ['useActiveEntity', 'useSyncActiveEntity', 'useChatActivity', 'useProcessingContext'] to the rule, so the rule stays `warn` everywhere else and only these named hook exports are exempted. This step 6 is the one item that is a policy call rather than a defect fix: if the user prefers splitting the files, step 6 swaps for that; also verify during implementation that allowExportNames is supported by the installed eslint-plugin-react-refresh@0.5.3. TESTS / VERIFICATION (there is no test suite in this repo, per CLAUDE.md — verification is typecheck + lint + build + manual checks, and no test suite may be invented): `npm run lint` must report 0 problems, down from 16 — the primary gate and the whole point of the change; `npm run typecheck` clean, which is what actually proves step 2 is sound, because removing `any` means every property access in those cases is now checked so a wrong guard surfaces here; `npm run build` clean; `deno check supabase/functions/_shared/khaos.ts` as a best-effort check, since that file imports toolsCore.ts directly and lives outside tsconfig.json's include: ["src"], confirming the Edge-function consumer still typechecks; manual browser checks for steps 3-5, the only user-visible surfaces — mobile drawer opens and closes itself on navigating to another route, chat sheet likewise, Esc and Cmd+K still close the drawer, Cmd+K opens the palette with an EMPTY query after a previous search (the behaviour the deleted effect provided), and the Staging Academy icon still renders in FIELDS_CONFIG; plus an agent smoke test for step 2 exercising the coercion paths the retyping touches — a query_rows with `filters` as a real array, as a JSON string, and as a {column: value} map, plus one update_rows with a `reason` so backfillReason is covered. Deliberately OUT of scope, recorded in the backlog item so they don't get lost: adding a lint job to CI (nothing would stop problem #17 from landing otherwise), and either wiring up or removing the unused vite-plugin-eslint devDependency.
